newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mobutu has health checks in Monaco hospital.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu has health checks in Monaco hospital.

text.p: Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko underwent checks at a hospital in Monaco on Friday, a day after his arrival in southern France following treatment for prostate cancer, officials said.

A spokesman for the principality said Mobutu had left the Princess Grace hospital after the checks. The spokesman said he had no more details but French radio, in an unconfirmed report, said Mobutu also underwent minor surgery.

Mobutu's spokesman said on Thursday the president, who has spent only three weeks in Zaire since last August, was in France to consult his doctors following treatment for prostate cancer in Switzerland last year.
Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila said the head of state was simply fleeing Zaire.
Before returning to Zaire three weeks ago, Mobutu spent six weeks at his palatial villa in the Riviera town of Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, where aides said he was recuperating from cancer treatment.

On his return to Zaire, he carried out a major reshuffle in the government and the army high command in preparation for an intended counter-attack on positions captured by rebels holding a large tract of eastern Zaire.
The rebels have vowed to march to Kinshasa to overthrow the president, who has ruled the mineral-rich country for 31 years.
